records.description: Pola Browser is a productivity-focused browser for Mac. It supports extensions like Bitwarden and Proton Pass, offers floating tabs, cloud sync, and multi-window browsing. Enjoy themed backgrounds, smooth animations, and a customizable interface. Regular updates ensure a seamless experience.

records.name: neurospear.in
records.tagline: AI Sales Co-Pilot for SDRs
records.description: • Instead of using 4 tools (LinkedIn sales navigator+zoominfo/Lusha/Apollo.io+chatgpt+CRM) use only neurospear.ai • Instead of paying 18k per user per month spend 7.5k per user per month. Cost reduction by 60%. • SDR spends 5 hours on prospecting in a day, with neurospear.ai they will spend only 1 hours. Improve productivity by 4x • Pre-call BANT qualification report. Pre-call buyer centric discovery questions

records.name: Hide the Chat | Hide Website Chat Widget
records.tagline: Simple way to hide website chat widgets with a single click.
records.description: Simple way to hide website chat widgets with a single click. No browser extension required. Just click the bookmarklet to toggle website chat widgets to be visible or hidden. Some chat widgets are targeted specifically, but there is also a bit of a fallback way to pick out chat widgets that might be floating there. Also updated to try to not block accessibility widgets!

records.name: Forums
records.tagline: AI-powered Q&A for GitHub repositories.
records.description: Ask questions about any repo and AI agents will clone, explore, and grep the source code to provide source-backed answers.

records.name: Skima - Start Now
records.tagline: Decide what to do next, instantly
records.description: Skima helps you decide what to do next when you feel stuck. Just say what you’re about to do. Your words become tasks you can start immediately. Save common tasks. No planning, no setup. Skima helps you start now. It’s not about perfect schedules. It’s about not wasting the moment.

records.name: TypeFlow
records.tagline: Create stunning typing animations in seconds
records.description: TypeFlow is a browser-based tool that lets you create professional typing animations in seconds. Simply enter your text, customise your design and export. No video editing skills required.

records.name: Ratefluencer
records.tagline: Building trust in the influencer economy.
records.description: Find trusted influencers. Read real reviews from real people. See what customers think before you follow, buy, or partner with any influencer.

records.name: Thumbfa.st
records.tagline: Midjourney for YouTube Thumbnails—your face, every time
records.description: Drop in your face, grab inspiration from any YouTube thumbnail, describe your vision—AI generates it instantly. Iterate until perfect. 100x cheaper than a thumbnail designer.

records.name: SNACK'D
records.tagline: Meal plans for families with picky eaters & different diets
records.description: Snack’d is here to take the headache out of meal planning for families with specific dietary needs. Instead of a weekly meal plan that focus solely on macros & calorie counting, Snack’d focuses on creating a plan that lets your family eat together. Snack’d features include: - Customized meal plan, grocery list, & recipes for up to 6 family members - Ability to adjust time and budget to fit your needs - Meal plans that cater to dietary restrictions, picky eaters, & food allergies.

records.name: Omia Studio
records.tagline: Generate wireframes and real apps with AI + Python
records.description: An AI‑native studio to build real web/mobile apps: AI assembles the frontend from your wireframes or prompts; you connect your backend in Python—ship in minutes. Designed to provide clean control for application designers and developers while enabling collaboration.

records.name: Endfield DB & AIC Architect
records.tagline: The ultimate factory planner for Arknights: Endfield.
records.description: A powerful production calculator and database for Arknights: Endfield. Features include automatic cycle-dependency resolution (bottle loops), real-time power consumption tracking, and precise facility counts. Stop guessing, start engineering.

records.name: Convosify
records.tagline: Privacy-first AI conversation assistant.
records.description: Privacy-first AI conversation assistant for macOS. Catch toxic messages before you send with on-device ML - your data never leaves your Mac. Grammar check, tone analysis, translation. Works with Slack, Discord, Teams. Zero cloud, zero tracking.
